# Techmyrmidons

> Domain tool radars maintained by the Purple Movement's Evolve chapters: what practitioners actually use (Adopt/Trial/Assess/Hold), how each landscape moved 2022-2026, and a proof-of-work skill ladder per domain. Load a radar as context and ask: "given this radar and my ladder level, plan my next month."

## Provenance note

Entries are labeled [validated], [ai-seeded], or [contested]. The July 2026 baseline is AI-seeded (knowledge through January 2026) pending validation by the owning Evolve chapters. Treat [ai-seeded] entries as a well-informed draft, not settled truth.
